name: Python
desc: Python through a C# lens. Syntax, pandas, file I/O, SQL integration, generators, decorators, testing.
tip: Practice writing small scripts from scratch -- not reading solutions. Muscle memory under interview pressure is built only one way.

r: def f(lst=[]) is a bug -- same list persists across calls. Use lst=None.
yield one item at a time (lazy). List holds everything in memory.
f'{name}' is the modern standard for string interpolation.
Never concatenate user input. Use ? placeholders with pyodbc.
Returns a DataFrame in one call. Cleaner than cursor.fetchall().
@pytest.fixture creates reusable setup. Inject by parameter name.
python -m venv .venv. Isolates packages per project. Always use one.

parts.title: Python syntax for C# developers
parts.summary: Python and C# share the same concepts but with different syntax. Day 1 goal: re-express everything you know in C# in Python style -- new spelling, not new ideas…

parts.title: File I/O, CSV, JSON, environment variables
parts.summary: Data engineering is 80% reading files, transforming them, and writing files. Environment variables are the professional way to manage credentials.

parts.title: Pandas -- DataFrames, groupby, merge, pivot
parts.summary: Pandas is the standard Python library for tabular data. Every SQL operation you know has a pandas equivalent.

parts.title: Generators, decorators, context managers
parts.summary: These features distinguish idiomatic Python from basic Python. Generators are essential for large file processing.

parts.title: Python + SQL Server -- pyodbc, SQLAlchemy, parameterized queries
parts.summary: Connecting Python to SQL Server safely is the bridge between Python and SQL skills. Parameterized queries are a near-certain interview question.

parts.title: OOP, type hints, virtual environments
parts.summary:
Python OOP at professional level. Virtual environments are mandatory for any real project.

parts.title: requests, REST APIs, retry, rate limiting
parts.summary:
Fetching from REST APIs with proper error handling is core to the 50-source S&P pipeline.

parts.title: pytest -- unit testing, fixtures, parametrize, mocking
parts.summary: For data engineering, testing transformation logic (given this input DataFrame, expect this output DataFrame) is the most important skill.

parts.title: Python Async Internals & Event Loop
parts.summary: Understand python asyncio execution engine, TaskGroups (Python 3.11+), free-threaded Python 3.13 (GIL optional), and uvloop.

parts.title: Modern Data Engineering & Typing
parts.summary: Production Python data pipelines use pydantic v2, static typing with mypy, and zero-copy Apache Arrow processing with polars.
